profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer
profile.summary: I’m a positive person who thrives in collaborative environments and is passionate about technology, mentoring, and helping others. Since 2017, I’ve worked in software development across education, aerospace, healthcare, and biotech, building and maintaining enterprise systems.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description: Senior Software Engineer leading the design, development, and deployment of scalable, AI-enabled applications. Responsible for defining and guiding the technical direction of software development practices across the organization, including establishing standards, processes, and engineering strategy. Architects end-to-end solutions, implements AI governance, and ensures delivery of high-quality, production-ready systems. Partners closely with stakeholders to define project goals and align technical execution with business needs. Mentors junior and mid-level engineers, fostering continuous learning and strong engineering practices. Experienced in cloud platforms, AI integration, microservices, and modern development tools, with a focus on building impactful, scalable solutions.

positions.title: Senior Software Developer
positions.description: As a Senior Software Developer, I support and maintain an R&D application built in Ruby on Rails, overseeing bug fixes, soft updates, and upgrades. I mentor junior engineers, conduct code reviews, and assist with best practices in software development. My role also involves setting up and configuring new Linux servers to support various applications, performing system administration tasks such as monitoring, space management, and installation. Additionally, I develop drivers to interface with heme analyzers, ensuring seamless integration with other systems. I work closely with customers to understand their needs, provide technical solutions, and ensure system reliability.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Secret Security Clearance 

Test complex flight data portal for NASA that encompasses a large enterprise architecture and stores flight data in HDF5 file format. Follow an Agile process of Software Development for the government. Test new software programs following an enterprise architecture. Clearly and regularly communicate with management and technical support colleagues. Test, maintain and recommend software improvements to ensure strong functionality and optimization using Katalon Studio, Selenium, SoapUI, Junit, and JMeter. Work with experienced team members to conduct root cause analysis of issues, review new and existing code and/or perform integration, system, and acceptance testing. Write up-to-date knowledge of technological developments in the industry. Host meetings and development reviews.

positions.title: Application Developer
positions.description: Develop and maintain applications with Office 365, Microsoft SharePoint, Google Sites, SQL server, MySQL, and Web application design and development. Provide technical assistance by responding to inquiries regarding access-control requests, errors, problems, or questions with applications. Design and develop customization of application systems, including dashboard-like graphical user interfaces, web-application parts, enterprise system content integration, InfoPath forms, and workflows using SharePoint or similar environments.
